description: Controller class for GDPR-related actions in OpenCart, including displaying GDPR info, handling user requests for data export/removal, and processing success responses.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class managing GDPR information display, user actions, and success handling in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays GDPR information page if available, otherwise returns not_found action.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles user requests for GDPR data export or removal, validates input, prevents spam, and responds with JSON.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays success page after GDPR action, updates GDPR status if needed, or returns not_found.
